svg.title: Trust, scale and infrastructure
svg.desc: Evals, the instrument retest, cost per use, the 200-at-once load test, CI and the Google Cloud services.
svg.text: What we measured about ourselves, failures included, and what it all runs on. Shown live on /evidence.
84 cases each on 3.8 Flash and 3.5 Flash-Lite
19 first answers rejected, 18 fixed on retry
production: 7 answers stopped by a validator
in 30 days of logs (105 Gemini calls)
blur, noise, JPEG, measured by the real engine
room-light floor learned on 10 people, checked
Logged tokens and engine seconds × list prices; idle instances not included
SCALE · 200 PEOPLE PRESS MEASURE AT THE SAME MOMENT
all measured; the last in 939 s
The line lives in each api instance: oldest first, a place and an estimate, 409 to ask again.
Over 8 needs a quota raise; $0.47 of engine at any size
desktop and mobile; 0 serious axe issues
GitHub Actions: ruff and pytest for the api,
pytest for the engine, web lint, build, tests
Proof crawl: every Proof page as a retailer
and as a brand seat, in headless Chrome
Stored and measured in us-central1. Gemini 3.x answers from its global endpoint; live voice stays in us-central1. Delete my data removes everything at once.
Sources: web/src/data/evidence.json · docs/EVALS.md, docs/EVIDENCE.md, infra/README.md (Scale), engine/app/config.py · .github/workflows/ci.yml · infra/setup.sh
